extDescription.message: Clicks Allow on muse.ai approval cards for you. Trust only the sites and chats you pick. Unofficial, not affiliated with Meta.

modeTrustedDesc.message: New sites and chats ask you first

preferAlwaysDesc.message: muse remembers the site and stops asking

rateText.message: A quick review on the Chrome Web Store helps other people find it.

menuRate.message: Review on the Chrome Web Store

scopeSiteChat.message: This site, only from this chat

scopeChatWarn.message: It'll be allowed to open any site

pendingHint.message: If you answer a card in muse yourself, it disappears from here.

sitePlaceholder.message: Paste a URL or type a site, like x.com

siteInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a site. Try something like x.com.

siteLimitHint.message: To limit a site to certain chats, use Settings.

recentChatsEmpty.message: Chats show up here after their first approval card.

chatWarn.message: A trusted chat can open any site without asking. Only add chats you're sure about.

generalLead.message: When the extension should click Allow for you.

enabledDesc.message: Turn off to pause. Nothing gets clicked.

modeTrustedLongDesc.message: New sites and chats ask you first. Answer once in the popup and it's remembered.

modeAllLongDesc.message: Allows whatever Ren asks for, which skips the human check.

openBackgroundDesc.message: Requests from other chats only show a review banner, so the extension clicks Review first.

sitesLead.message: When Ren opens one of these sites, the extension clicks Allow. You can limit a site to certain chats.

chatPickEmpty.message: No chats have shown up yet.

siteStats.message: Allowed $1 times in the last 7 days, most recently $2.

siteStatsNone.message: Not used in the last 7 days.

chatsLead.message: Anything these chats (usually scheduled tasks) ask for gets allowed. Only add chats you're sure about.

chatNamePlaceholder.message: Exactly as it appears in muse

chatDetailWarn.message: This chat can open any site without asking, including sites it hasn't opened before.

logLead.message: The last $1 approval cards, stored only on this computer.

backupLead.message: Chrome browsers signed in to the same Google account sync your trusted lists automatically. Use this to move settings to a browser that isn't signed in, like one on a server.

exportDesc.message: Downloads a file with your mode and trusted sites and chats. Activity isn't included.

importDesc.message: Pick an exported file. It replaces your current settings.

importFailed.message: Couldn't read settings from that file.

importConfirm.message: Importing replaces your current settings. Continue?

aboutLead.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Meta or muse.ai.

issueDesc.message: Missed a card, clicked the wrong one, or stopped working after a muse update

welcomeTitle.message: Welcome to Auto Approve for Muse

welcomeSub.message: When Ren wants to open a website, muse shows an approval card and waits for you to click Allow. This extension can click it for you.

welcomeTrustedDesc.message: The first time a new site or chat shows up, it asks you. Answer once and it's allowed automatically after that.

welcomeAllDesc.message: The easiest option. Whatever Ren asks for is allowed, which skips the human check.

pinHint.message: Click the puzzle icon in the top right of Chrome and pin Auto Approve for Muse. A red number shows up on it when something is waiting for you.

welcomeFine.message: You can change this anytime from the toolbar icon. Unofficial, not affiliated with Meta or muse.ai.
